import sys, io, json, unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from unittest import mock
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
sys.argv = sys.argv[:1]
import test_drive as T

def executor_for(sub):
    return T.python_command(
        "import json, os, re\n"
        "from pathlib import Path\n"
        "Path('executor-work.txt').write_text('done\\n', encoding='utf-8')\n"
        "card = Path(os.environ['STAGE_WORK_ITEM_PATH'])\n"
        f"card.write_text(re.sub(r'(?m)^status: active$', {sub!r}, card.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), count=1), encoding='utf-8')\n"
        "card_rel = os.path.relpath(card, Path.cwd()).replace(os.sep, '/')\n"
        "log = Path(os.environ['STAGE_WORK_LOG_PATH'])\n"
        "report = ('\\n### Executor report\\nWhat changed: x\\nWhy: y\\nDecisions made: None\\nWork not done: None\\n"
        "Changed paths (JSON):\\n' + json.dumps(sorted(['executor-work.txt', card_rel])) + '\\nReview request: r\\n')\n"
        "log.write_text(log.read_text(encoding='utf-8') + report, encoding='utf-8')\n")

class P(T.DriveTest):
    def test_supervised_fields(self):
        for sub, field in [("status: completed","status"),("status: active\\nreview: passed","review"),
                           ("status: active\\nretrospective: done","retrospective"),
                           ("status: active\\nretrospective_ref: R-1","retrospective_ref")]:
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                tmp, root = self.make_project(executor=executor_for(sub))
                with tmp:
                    T.write_card(root/".stage","W-00000002",parent="W-00000001",acceptance=(T.PASS_COMMAND,))
                    T.initialize_git(root)
                    r = self.run_cli(root, "--execute")
                    card = (root/".stage/work/current/W-00000001/W-00000002/_story.md").read_text()
                print(field, r.returncode, [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if "close-owned" in l][:1], "status: active" in card, field+":" in card and field!="status")
                self.assertNotEqual(0, r.returncode); self.assertIn("close-owned", r.stdout)
    def test_unattended_verification(self):
        tmp, root = self.make_project(executor=executor_for("status: active\\nverification: passed"),
            limits={"max_attempts_per_item":1,"max_iterations":1,"max_wall_clock_seconds":3600})
        with tmp:
            T.write_card(root/".stage","W-00000001",autonomous=True,acceptance=(T.PASS_COMMAND,))
            T.initialize_git(root)
            drive = self.load_module()
            args = mock.Mock(target="W-00000001",timeout=30,limit_action_seconds=30,skip_preflight=True)
            with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as out:
                res = drive.run_unattended(args, root, root/".stage", drive.time.time())
            card = (root/".stage/work/current/W-00000001/_story.md").read_text()
            head = T.git(root,"show","HEAD:.stage/work/current/W-00000001/_story.md").stdout
        print("unattended", res, [l for l in out.getvalue().splitlines() if "close-owned" in l][:1], "verification:" in card, "verification:" in head)
        self.assertIn("close-owned", out.getvalue()); self.assertNotIn("verification: passed", card); self.assertNotIn("verification: passed", head)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(defaultTest=["P.test_supervised_fields","P.test_unattended_verification"], verbosity=1)
EOF
